stops.note: a nickname for members of the Nizari Ismaili sect based at Alamut
crusaders in the Levant carried the term back to Europe
stops.meaning: a member of the secretive killer sect

stops.note: generalized from the sect's name to any hired killer
borrowed via Italian accounts of the Crusades
stops.meaning: a murderer, especially of a political figure

current_meaning: a person who murders a prominent person, often for political or religious motives
